exec: pm.test("Matches Priya, Rahul, Ananya", () => pm.expect(names).to.eql(["Ananya Rao", "Priya Nair", "Rahul Mehta"]));
pm.test("Results are sorted by score descending", () => { const s = body.results.map(r => r.score); pm.expect(s).to.eql([...s].sort((a, b) => b - a)); });
pm.test("Priya ranks first (open to work + immediate joiner)", () => pm.expect(body.results[0].fullName).to.eql("Priya Nair"));
pm.test("Ananya ranks last (not open to work)", () => pm.expect(body.results[2].fullName).to.eql("Ananya Rao"));
pm.test("Returns Rahul and Ananya only", () => pm.expect(names).to.eql(["Ananya Rao", "Rahul Mehta"]));
